lifecycle.retention: Retain the REL-03 contract and exact targeted evidence; no release authority.

value: NgwFullSnapshotIndex stores full-pull identity/backup/delete/cleanup sets in a disposable disk SQLite index (512KiB cache, FILE temporary storage, constant-time counters). NgwFeatureBudgetReader bounds each feature before WKT materialization; NgwSyncResourceBudget checks heap headroom, actual streaming disk writes and a 32MiB free-space reserve. Single-feature budget heap/64 capped8MiB; error text capped64KiB. Local row lengths are checked in SQL before Java hydration. Up to512 destructive IDs use selective backup; larger plans use the existing whole-layer fail-closed backup API. No new IGISApplication API or remote payload/schema.

Cancellation, staged-write failure and SQLite apply errors preserve prior DB/outbox and clean owned staging/index sidecars. HTTP206 admission and postcommit cache publication retain their existing boundaries. Direct tests cover actual technical SQLite rollback, outbox/photo retention, retry, huge feature refusal and large-plan backup routing on API26/36. Injected resource failures are not physical-device ENOSPC or publication acceptance.
